thread:
maria: P1-ish in staging — canary deploy to inference pool 'v2-small-batch' causing 503 spikes and timeouts for a subset of requests. Opening war room: https://warroom.redwood.example/r/7483921123. On-call, please ack and join.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-11734 triggered (inference-503-rate) — paging on-call.
jamal: acked. I'm joining the war room now. Assign to me as owner.
maria: assigning owner -> @jamal. Can you confirm scope (hosts, region, customer-impact)?
jamal: early look — errors concentrated on staging-gpu-3 and staging-gpu-4 (eu-west-2). Appears after canary with new batching config; KV/ prefix cache hit dropped. Likely batching misconfig. Affects ~3 test customers + internal e2e.
patrick: I'll draft a customer-facing status snippet. Suggest: short notice "We are investigating increased inference errors in staging affecting some API calls; no customer-facing production impact reported yet." Will paste draft below.
patrick: ```Status: We are investigating errors affecting inference requests in our staging environment after a recent canary release. Impact: a small number of integration tests and staging customers may see request failures or increased latency. Mitigation: on-call has been paged and a rollback is being prepared. Next update: 15 minutes.```
maria: jamal — can you start rollback to previous canary if you confirm config regression? Include the helm/tf command.
jamal: starting rollback now. Command: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=12` then `./deploy/scripts/verify-staging.sh inference` — running now. Posting logs in war room.
ops-bot: Pager acknowledged by jamal. War room link active.
jamal: rollback initiated, monitoring. KV cache miss rate dropping on staging-gpu-3 from 82% -> 38% in 90s. Errors trending down.
maria: good. Patrick — prepare brief internal comms for Sales/CSM: one-line + recommended talking points.
patrick: internal comms draft: "Staging canary caused transient inference 5xxs for a small set of customers in staging. Rollback initiated; no production customers affected. Action: SRE rolled back canary and monitoring shows service recovering. We will notify if any customer-facing impact appears"
maria: perfect. I'll notify growth and CSM channels once rollback finishes. Jamal, keep pinging recovery metrics and confirm when fully back to baseline.
jamal: will do. If errors <1% for 5 consecutive minutes, I'll close the war room and push a short status update.
incident-bot: Update scheduled: next reminder in 10m.
maria: thanks team — keeping this thread as the canonical kickoff/hand-off record.
patrick: publishing the status-page draft to #statuspage-drafts for review.
jamal: final check: latency back to normal and 200 rate stable. Marking as monitoring.
maria: acknowledged. Preparing postmortem seed and comms checklist.
